notes.title: Development Update & New Timeline
notes.notes:
[p]✨ [b]Little Update[/b][/p][p]
I recently started a new job, which is why I’ve been a bit quiet.[/p][p]This means the release of [b]Super Tennis Breakout[/b] will be slightly delayed. I used to work on it full-time, but now I’ll continue part-time. Right now, I’m aiming for a [b]December release[/b] if everything goes well.[/p][p][/p][p]🎾 The demo is currently offline, but I’ll be updating it soon with fresh improvements and then re-releasing it![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support and patience ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Super Tennis Breakout – Dev Livestream for the Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m the solo developer of Super Tennis Breakout, and I’ll be going live to celebrate the launch of the playable demo for Steam Next Fest!

In this livestream, I’ll be:

    Playing through the demo live

    Answering your questions in chat

    Sharing some behind-the-scenes dev insights

    Talking about what’s coming next in development

Whether you’ve played the demo already or are just curious, I’d love to have you stop by. This is my first game and first stream, and I’m super excited (and a little nervous!) to share it with the world.

Thanks for checking it out — hope to see you during the stream!
